# MuregiScore Technologies — Comprehensive Technical Knowledge Base

This file provides exhaustive reference data for AI agents, generative search engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Gemini, Claude), and automated crawlers indexing MuregiScore Technologies.

## 2. Umbrella Structure & Divisions

### Division 01: Business Software
- **Focus**: CRM systems, operational pipelines, customer lifecycle management for African SMEs.
- **Architectural Highlights**:
  - Multi-tenant tenant isolation with schema-level segregation.
  - BullMQ background queues running on Redis for asynchronous task processing (invoicing, notifications).
  - Configurable sales pipelines with drag-and-drop Kanban state machines.
  - Granular role-based access control (RBAC).
- **Flagship Reference**: [Core CRM Architecture Model](https://github.com/Muregis/Core-Crm-model)

### Division 02: Education Technology
- **Focus**: K-12 and tertiary institution administration, CBC (Competency-Based Curriculum) compliance, automated fee collection, and algorithmic timetable clash resolution.
- **Flagship Platforms**:
  - **EduCore School Management System**:
    - URL: https://educore-school-management-system-pi.vercel.app
    - Code: https://github.com/Muregis/educore-school-management-system
    - Features: Student information system (SIS), guardian portals, automated billing, Paystack & M-Pesa integration, academic grading.
  - **EduCore Ratiba Solver**:
    - URL: https://educoreratiba.vercel.app
    - Code: https://github.com/Muregis/Educore-Ratiba
    - Features: Algorithmic timetable generation avoiding double-booking of rooms, teachers, and practical laboratories; calibrated for CBC dual-pathway learning.

### Division 03: Payments & System Integrations
- **Focus**: Bridging business software to telecom financial rails.
- **Integrations**:
  - Safaricom Daraja STK Push (Lipa na M-Pesa Online): Sub-second prompt triggers on customer smartphones.
  - C2B Paybill & Till Webhook Listeners: Real-time validation and confirmation endpoint workers.
  - Instant Ledger Reconciliation: Automatic receipt generation and database reconciliation without human intervention.
  - B2C Bulk Disbursements: Automated payroll and vendor payouts.

### Division 04: Industry-Specific Systems
- **Focus**: Tailored platforms designed for specialized biological, agricultural, and logistics realities.
- **Flagship Platform**:
  - **Livestock Management Platform**:
    - URL: https://livestock-management-app.vercel.app
    - Code: https://github.com/Muregis/Livestock-Management-App
    - Features: Digital animal records, genealogical lineage/pedigree tracking, milk yield recording & trend graphs, vaccination schedules, herd health history.

### Division 05: Websites & Digital Platforms
- **Focus**: Fast, accessible, conversion-focused web engineering for commercial services.
- **Flagship Deployments**:
  - **Sawa Repairs & Solar Solutions**:
    - URL: https://sawa-solar-solution-website.vercel.app
    - Code: https://github.com/Muregis/Sawa-solar--solution-website
    - Domain: Solar water heating, electrical repairs, construction quotations.
  - **Gracious Love Academy**:
    - URL: https://graciousloveacademy-school-website.vercel.app
    - Code: https://github.com/Muregis/School-Website
    - Domain: Institutional school portal, parent prospectus, fee structures.

### Division 06: Bespoke Engineering
- **Focus**: Custom algorithm development, legacy system modernization, database schema re-architecting, and SLA-backed infrastructure scaling.

## 3. Engineering Method & African Operating Reality
MuregiScore builds systems designed specifically for:
1. **Network Resilience**: Handling unstable 3G/4G connectivity through optimistic client updates, offline persistence, and idempotent API retries.
2. **Mobile First & USSD/SMS/WhatsApp Bridges**: Allowing operators to receive alerts and manage notifications via messaging channels.
3. **Cash-to-Digital Transition**: Automated M-Pesa reconciliation preventing ledger leakage and human error.
